acip: GANG GI TSE BDAG MA 'ONGS PA'I DUS NA BLA NA MED PA YANG DAG PAR RDZOGS PA'I BYANG CHUB MNGON PAR RDZOGS PAR SANGS RGYAS PA DE NA SEMS CAN GANG DAG 'DOD CHAGS DANG, ZHE SDANG DANG, GTI MUG GIS BSGRIBS TE, TSUL KHRIMS 'CHAL BAR GYUR PA DE DAG SDIG PA KUN TU SPYOD DE,
wylie: gang gi tshe bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de na sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang, zhe sdang dang, gti mug gis bsgribs te, tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur pa de dag sdig pa kun tu spyod de
english: In future days, when I reach total enlightenment—when I reach my own matchless, perfect, and complete Buddhahood—there will be certain beings who are blinded by ignorant liking, and ignorant disliking, and dark ignorance itself.  They will live in broken morality, and devote themselves constantly to actions that harm others.
